title: Anointed Preaching That Offends
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner shares the importance of anointed preaching and conviction in the church, highlighting how it brings about change, miracles, and freedom from the power of the Holy Ghost. Join Pastor Chris as he explains why we must yield to rebuke and exhortation, and how we can't afford to be hardened or calloused towards the Word of God. This sermon is a call to return to old-fashioned, Bible-quoting, Holy Ghost-preaching that cuts to the heart and sets people free.
